summary: Career Connect MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 46/46 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (login/register/me/update, duplicate 409, wrong-pw 401), jobs list+filters (q/location/category/type/level)+featured+detail+404, employer CRUD (create/update/close/delete + RBAC 403 for seeker), applications (apply, duplicate 409, mine, employer-view, status update, invalid status 400, RBAC 403), saved jobs toggle+list+ids, notifications (new_application to employer, status_update to seeker, read-all), admin (stats, users role filter, toggle-active, admin jobs+toggle, add/delete category), and RBAC (seeker/employer cannot access admin, seeker cannot access employer, employer cannot apply). Frontend: landing loads, login routes seeker->home w/ dashboard, employer->dashboard w/ 4 active jobs & 2 total applicants, admin->stats screen (3 seekers/4 employers/10 jobs/9 active/2 apps). Search screen shows jobs with category & type chips. Job detail opens & Apply Now presents a cover-letter modal. Post Job form fully rendered with all required testIDs. React Native web deprecation warnings detected (shadow* props, pointerEvents) - non-blocking.

issues: Seeded/test job with description 'x' looks empty on detail page (leftover test data, not a code bug)

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Appears repeatedly in console.
React Native Web deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace RN 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' (or use Platform-specific style) to silence deprecation warnings on web.
Optional cleanup: migrate any pointerEvents prop usage to style.pointerEvents.
Nothing blocking; all core flows and RBAC verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines - still manageable but consider splitting routers (auth/jobs/applications/admin) into modules if it grows further.
GET /api/files/{path} accepts any valid JWT (does not verify ownership) - acceptable for MVP but note as future improvement.
PUT /api/jobs uses full JobIn payload requiring all fields; partial edits will overwrite optional fields - fine for MVP but consider a JobPatchIn.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (landing, login for 3 roles, seeker home, employer dashboard/post-form, admin dashboard, search, job detail, apply modal)

seed_data_creation: Tests created transient TEST_* users/jobs/categories; TestEmployerJobs & TestApplications leave a couple of TEST_ jobs (e.g., 'TEST_QA Engineer v2' closed, 'TEST_ApplyJob' active) attached to seeded Google employer to verify UI-visible data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 46 pytest cases green against public URL. Seeded creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. testIDs used: login-email, login-password, login-submit, nav-signin, tab-search (Search text tab), job-<id>, save-<id>, search-input, cat-*, type-*, level-*, post-title/desc/location/req/benefits, salary-min/max, publish-job, apply-btn. Employer post form uses publish-job (not post-submit).
